name: Kyuukyoku Mahou Shoujo Zettai☆Aneki
original_name: 究極魔法少女 絶対☆姉貴
source:
Akira’s older sister Hikari is amazing, placing tops in the national mock exams, almost setting world records in athletics and she’s even a ‘mahou shoujo’ that takes care of bad guys. As the school’s representative, she was given the opportunity to enact any proposition that she wants. She announces to everyone that she will be attacking any club that she wishes and if they lose to her, then they will be disbanded. With a smile, she wished everyone good luck. To save their ‘volunteer club’, they decide to fight back with all they’ve got.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
朗的姐姐光无所不能：她能在全国模拟考名列前茅，田径成绩几乎刷新世界纪录，还是一名收拾恶棍的「魔法少女」。作为学校代表，她获得了贯彻任何提案的权力。她向所有人宣布，自己会向任何心血来潮选中的社团发起挑战；若对方输给她，社团便将解散。她微笑着祝大家好运。为了守住「志愿者社团」，众人决定全力反击。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
